name: klaatcode-bench-v3
description: 50 harder self-contained coding tasks with objective pass/fail verifiers. Heavy long-context weight (15 tasks, 12-25 file fixtures). Categories: bugfix (subtle/async/unicode/tz), implement (real algorithms), long-context bug hunts, multi-file refactors, refactor, spec-parsing. Run with BENCH_SUITE=suite-v3.json.

tasks.prompt: memoizeAsync in src/memo.ts is supposed to deduplicate concurrent calls with the same key (one underlying fetch per key while in flight), but the tests in src/memo.test.ts show the loader firing multiple times under concurrency. Fix src/memo.ts so all tests pass. Do not edit the test file.

dailyBuckets in src/buckets.ts groups timestamps into local calendar days for a fixed UTC offset, but tests in src/buckets.test.ts fail around day boundaries. Fix the bucketing logic so all tests pass. Do not edit the test file.

truncateDisplay in src/truncate.ts must never split a user-perceived character (emoji, ZWJ sequences, combining marks, flags). Tests in src/truncate.test.ts fail. Fix src/truncate.ts so all tests pass. Do not edit the test file.

The ledger in src/ledger.ts accumulates floating-point error across many small transactions and its balances drift off by cents; src/ledger.test.ts fails. Fix the money handling so all tests pass. Do not edit the test file.

The LRU+TTL cache in src/cache.ts mishandles the interaction between recency updates and expiry (expired entries still count as recent, gets don't refresh recency correctly). Fix src/cache.ts so src/cache.test.ts passes. Do not edit the test file.

debounce in src/debounce.ts supports {leading, trailing} options but the semantics are wrong (leading call swallowed, trailing fires with stale args, cancel doesn't). Fix src/debounce.ts so src/debounce.test.ts passes. Do not edit the test file.
retryWithBackoff in src/retry.ts computes exponential delays that overflow / ignore maxDelay and retries non-retryable errors. Fix src/retry.ts so src/retry.test.ts passes. Do not edit the test file.

The bounded task queue in src/queue.ts must run at most `concurrency` jobs at once, preserve completion-order guarantees described in the tests, and reject when full — but src/queue.test.ts fails. Fix src/queue.ts. Do not edit the test file.

safeJoin in src/paths.ts is meant to confine resolved paths inside a root directory, but tests in src/paths.test.ts show escapes via '..', mixed separators, and encoded segments. Fix src/paths.ts so all tests pass. Do not edit the test file.
deepMerge in src/merge.ts corrupts arrays, merges __proto__/constructor keys, and shares references between input and output. Fix src/merge.ts so src/merge.test.ts passes. Do not edit the test file.

Implement nextRun in src/cron.ts: given a 5-field cron expression (min hour dom month dow, supporting *, lists, ranges, steps) and a Date, return the next matching Date strictly after it. Spec in the stub comment; tests in src/cron.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.
Implement globMatch in src/glob.ts supporting *, ?, **, {a,b} alternation and [abc] classes per the stub spec. Tests in src/glob.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement the TokenBucket rate limiter in src/ratelimit.ts (capacity, refill rate, injectable clock, tryTake(n), msUntilAvailable(n)) per the stub spec. Tests in src/ratelimit.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement topoSort in src/topo.ts: deterministic topological order (lexicographic tie-break) and, on cycles, throw CycleError carrying one concrete cycle path per the stub spec. Tests in src/topo.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement diffLines in src/diff.ts producing a minimal edit script (equal/insert/delete ops) between two string arrays per the stub spec (LCS-based). Tests in src/diff.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement the incremental JSON value scanner in src/jstream.ts: feed(chunk) accepts arbitrary chunk boundaries of a stream of whitespace-separated JSON values and emits each complete value; handles strings with escapes, nesting, and numbers split across chunks. Spec in stub; tests in src/jstream.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement the interval set operations in src/intervals.ts (normalize, union, intersect, subtract, freeSlots within bounds) per the stub spec. Tests in src/intervals.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement wrapText in src/wrap.ts: width-aware word wrap that preserves existing newlines, breaks overlong words with a hyphen, collapses trailing spaces, per the stub spec. Tests in src/wrap.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement satisfies(version, range) in src/semver.ts supporting exact, ^, ~, >=, <=, >, <, hyphen ranges and || alternatives (no prerelease handling) per the stub spec. Tests in src/semver.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Implement parseCsv in src/csv.ts per RFC 4180: quoted fields, escaped quotes, embedded newlines and commas, CRLF handling, ragged-row error reporting with line numbers, per the stub spec. Tests in src/csv.test.ts. Do not edit the test file.

Invoice totals come out a cent off for some carts (see failing tests in src/billing/invoice.test.ts). The bug is somewhere in the pricing/billing pipeline — find it and fix it. Do not edit test files.

Feature flag resolution must honor precedence user override > org override > environment default > global default, but the failing tests in src/flags/resolve.test.ts show the wrong value winning in some cases. Find and fix the bug. Do not edit test files.

Stale data is served after certain writes (failing tests in src/store/consistency.test.ts). One write path fails to invalidate/version the cache like the others do. Find and fix it. Do not edit test files.

The daily-active report is off by small counts near midnight (failing tests in src/analytics/report.test.ts). Somewhere in the analytics pipeline local time and UTC are mixed. Find and fix the inconsistency. Do not edit test files.

One route in the API layer enforces permissions incorrectly (failing tests in src/api/authz.test.ts — viewers can modify something they shouldn't). Audit the route handlers and fix the broken check. Do not edit test files.

Downstream projections receive events in the wrong order under certain sequences (failing tests in src/events/projection.test.ts). One publisher violates the bus's ordering contract. Find and fix it. Do not edit test files.

Paginated listings skip or duplicate items across pages (failing tests in src/repo/pagination.test.ts). One repository method mixes offset and cursor semantics. Find and fix it. Do not edit test files.

Retried payment submissions can double-charge (failing tests in src/payments/idempotency.test.ts). The retry path misses the idempotency mechanism the rest of the pipeline uses. Find and fix it. Do not edit test files.
Shipping quotes are wrong for some parcels (failing tests in src/shipping/quote.test.ts). One module in the pipeline mixes metric and imperial units. Find and fix it. Do not edit test files.

After a field rename in the user model, one code path still reads the old field and returns undefined (failing tests in src/users/profile.test.ts). Find the stale reader and fix it consistently with the rest of the codebase. Do not edit test files.

A deprecated configuration source is still consulted and overrides the documented one in some cases (failing tests in src/config/load.test.ts). Find where the dead path leaks in and fix resolution to match the documented order. Do not edit test files.

Amounts in zero-decimal currencies (JPY, KRW) display and sum wrong in one part of the app (failing tests in src/money/format.test.ts). Find the formatter/aggregator that hardcodes 2 decimal places and fix it using the currency table the rest of the code uses. Do not edit test files.
Rate limiting meant to be per-user throttles all users together under load (failing tests in src/middleware/limits.test.ts). Find the accidentally shared state and fix it. Do not edit test files.
One logging path emits unredacted PII while all others redact (failing tests in src/logging/redact.test.ts). Find the path that bypasses redaction and fix it consistently. Do not edit test files.

Search results with equal scores come back in unstable/wrong order between calls (failing tests in src/search/rank.test.ts). Find the comparator at fault in the ranking pipeline and fix the documented tie-break. Do not edit test files.

Three modules duplicate subtly-different validation logic; the new shared module src/validation/core.ts (currently a stub) must become the single source of truth and all three call sites must use it. Tests in src/validation/core.test.ts and the three modules' tests must pass. Do not edit test files.

The domain type 'Shipment' was renamed to 'Consignment' in src/domain/types.ts but the rest of the codebase still references the old name/fields, so nothing compiles and tests fail. Complete the rename across all files. Tests in src/. Do not edit test files.

Modules call the concrete FileStore directly, making the failing tests (which inject a fake store via the new Storage interface in src/storage/iface.ts) impossible to pass. Refactor call sites to accept the injected interface. Do not edit test files.

Introduce the typed error hierarchy stubbed in src/errors/taxonomy.ts (NotFound, Conflict, Validation, Upstream) and make the service modules throw/propagate them so the failing handler tests (which assert on error types and HTTP mappings) pass. Do not edit test files.

Split the monolithic config loader so defaults, file, and env layers live in separate modules composed by src/config/index.ts, with the merge/precedence behavior the failing tests in src/config/index.test.ts specify. Do not edit test files.

Add the v2 API handlers (new response envelope, renamed fields) in src/api/v2/ reusing v1 business logic without duplicating it, per the failing tests in src/api/v2/handlers.test.ts. v1 tests must keep passing. Do not edit test files.
A circular import between modules leaves one binding undefined at runtime (failing tests in src/). Restructure the modules to break the cycle without changing public behavior. Do not edit test files.

Implement the test-data builder stubbed in src/testkit/builder.ts (fluent, immutable steps, sensible defaults, cross-entity references) that the failing tests across several modules rely on. Do not edit test files.

src/pipeline.ts is nested error-first callbacks. Convert it to async/await with the exact same observable behavior (ordering, error propagation, partial-failure semantics) so the new async tests in src/pipeline.test.ts pass. Do not edit test files.

Replace the stateful ReportBuilder class with the pure-function API stubbed in src/report/fn.ts (same outputs, no shared mutable state), making the failing tests pass while the legacy class tests keep passing via the compatibility wrapper. Do not edit test files.

Five near-identical webhook handlers differ only in field mapping and validation; the failing tests specify a single table-driven dispatcher in src/webhooks/dispatch.ts. Refactor to it, preserving each handler's behavior exactly. Do not edit test files.

src/importer.ts mixes thrown strings, error codes, and null returns. The failing tests specify one Result-based API (ok/err with typed reasons). Refactor the module to it, preserving decision logic exactly. Do not edit test files.

Implement generateToc in src/toc.ts exactly per SPEC.md in the repo root (heading extraction, GitHub-style slugs, duplicate suffixes, depth filtering, code-fence exclusion). Tests in src/toc.test.ts. Do not edit the test file or the spec.

Implement the record-filter DSL described in SPEC.md (field comparisons, and/or/not, parentheses, string/number/bool literals, error cases) in src/filter.ts. Tests in src/filter.test.ts. Do not edit the test file or the spec.

Implement the workflow state machine defined by the transition tables in SPEC.md (states, guarded transitions, entry actions, illegal-transition errors, history) in src/workflow.ts. Tests in src/workflow.test.ts. Do not edit the test file or the spec.
